note: Presale of a three-building, 5-storey apartment complex near Varna by Forest Club Varna OOD from EUR 1,629/m2, marketed in English. The published permit No. 56/23.04.2025 is confirmed in Varna's AGUP register but covers only section No. 4. Bulgarian media report that Forest Club Varna is the company behind the separate unpermitted Baba Alino complex, that buyers there paid under reservation agreements, and that the Varna District Court placed a lien on the company's properties in July 2026. flags.text: Novini.bg reported in May 2026 that Forest Club Varna OOD is the owner company of the unpermitted complex in the Baba Alino forest area near Varna.
Novini.bg reported in July 2026 that the Varna District Court imposed a lien on properties of Forest Club Varna in a claim by a Dutch family seeking repayment for a Baba Alino apartment.

Novinite reported in June 2026 that authorities exposed 104 buildings built without permits at Baba Alino in a Natura 2000 zone, and that Forest Club buyers had signed only reservation agreements; the investor disputes are before the courts.
